name: Legacy spells (2014 books)
blurb: Spells from Xanathar’s, Tasha’s and the other 2014 books that were never reprinted for 2024, with the 2024 classes that can use them.
contents: 135 spells: Xanathar’s (78), Wildemount (15), Tasha’s (11), Acquisitions Inc. (7), Fizban’s (6), Strixhaven (4), Book of Many Things (3), Kwalish (3), Spelljammer (2), Icewind Dale (2), Sigil (2), Ravnica (1), A Verdant Tomb (1)
Class lists for the 2024 classes, so players can add them to their sheets
Stat lines, damage types, saving throws, conditions and areas, with the book and page for the full rules
16 dunamancy and guild spells with no class list say who can learn them
about: The 2024 rules allow older spells with the Game Master’s say-so. Spells reprinted for 2024, such as Toll the Dead and Ice Knife, are left out here: they come with the free rules or More 2024 spells.
